description: This file contains a test implementation of a Mattermost plugin, including configuration management, event handling for posted messages, and plugin initialization.

classes.name: configuration
classes.description: Represents the plugin configuration with team and channel names, and resolved channel ID.

classes.name: HelpPlugin
classes.description: Implements the Mattermost plugin interface, managing configuration and message handling.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current plugin configuration safely under read lock.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Replaces the current plugin configuration safely under write lock.

methods.name: OnConfigurationChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the plugin configuration, loading new settings and resolving channel ID.

methods.name: MessageHasBeenPosted
methods.description: Automatically replies to help requests in the configured channel, ignoring plugin's own posts and non-help messages.
